text:
Core scaffold is built and compiles clean. Server starts on port 3000 with `npm run dev`. All expected files exist:
- src/index.ts, src/app.ts, src/webhook.ts, src/gateway.ts, src/admin.ts

You can now run e2e tests. Note:
1. Admin API requires `GATEWAY_API_KEY` env var (or uses 'test-api-key' default)
2. `POST /admin/bots` validates token via real Telegram `getMe` — will fail for mock tokens. Might need a test-mode or mock.
3. `GET /admin/bots` returns a flat array (matching test expectation)

Go ahead and run the tests.
